notes.title: Ways of Survival
notes.content: [h2][b]Two new classes[/b][/h2][h3]Boulders Taming[/h3][p]The unique 'Monolith' skill creates a piercing stone projectile that periodically releases stones at a random target.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45032046/33fb00079b9f93b2ad40988e739d7426873e41c9.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Flesh Burning[/h3][p]'Great Pain' skill provokes a fire explosion when taking damage and 'Blood Spatter' passive skill sets the ground beneath each fire explosion on fire.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45032046/9a798b1cd27bded3affa3e6c22af66a3cfaf2689.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]New mechanics[/b][/h2][h3]Cumulative effect[/h3][p]Some abilities require a certain damage/healing threshold to activate. For example: 'Resonance' evolution causes a stone explosion for every 30 units of minion healing.[/p][p][/p][h3]Scaling up from healing and health[/h3][p]Some abilities allow you to enhance skills by increasing healing and also by increasing or decreasing the character's health. For example: 'Inspiration' upgrade gives +1% to minions' damage for every +1% increase in healing level.[/p][p][/p][h3]Assigning properties[/h3][p]Skills can give additional properties to the character and minions. For example: the passive skill 'Best Friend' gives the character an ability to respond with physical damage to damage received.[/p][p][/p][h3]Reducing enemy health[/h3][p]'Remedy' evolution has the unique property of reducing the max HP of enemies when hit by a stone projectile.[/p][p][/p][h3]Distance matters[/h3][p]Some abilities become more powerful or weaker depending on distance. For example: 'Voodoo' upgrade increases damage against targets more than 3 meters away.[/p][p][/p][h3]Passive healing[/h3][p]Periodic self-healing that cannot be increased.[/p][p][/p][h3]Lighting for passive skills[/h3][p]Active skills that are affected by passives are now highlighted with a yellow stroke.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]New items[/b][/h2][p]• [b]6[/b] active skills[/p][p]• [b]17[/b] evolutions[/p][p]• [b]26[/b] passive skills[/p][p]• [b]13[/b] upgrades[/p]

notes.title: Hotfix for "Clear Description"
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug with incorrect display of the game window.
[*]Fixed visual bugs.
[/list]

notes.title: Clear Description
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Ability descriptions now contain a lot of useful information to help you put together the most effective build.
[*]The game balance has been reworked a bit.
[/list]

notes.title: Performance Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Significantly improved the overall performance of the game.
[*]Also improved average frame rate when many projectiles and effects appear.
[*]More variation in the application of existing evolutions.
[*]Many bugs have been fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content:
[h3]Change log[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added buttons to change the game speed.
[*] Additional optimization was performed.
[/list]
